newsitem.title: USA: Croatia's Tudjman seriously ill with cancer - CNN.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Tudjman seriously ill with cancer - CNN.

text.p: Croatian President Franjo Tudjman is seriously ill with cancer and has been admitted to a Washington hospital for treatment, CNN said on Friday citing U.S. government sources.
"The Croatian president has been admitted to Walter Reed Medical Center here in Washington... We are told (he is) very sick, with cancer," CNN said.

The Croatian state-run news agency HINA reported on Wednesday in Zagreb that Tudjman had taken a short break for a "regular medical check-up." A spokesman for his office in Zagreb declined then to say how long the break would be or where the check-up was taking place.

The non-smoking, 74-year-old leader has played a prominent role in the tumult surrounding the collapse of former Yugoslavia and the negotiation of the so-called Dayton peace accords on Bosnia signed a year ago.
A spokesperson at Walter Reed hospital said their policy was not to comment on diplomats being treated there. There was no immediate response from the Croatian embassy.
